notes: The persons ... shall be for Jehovah is a verbless clause; rule 49 puts the copula on the lamed heading the prepositional predicate.
Competing reading: the copula could be read as the noun's under rule 20, but the predicate here is the prepositional phrase, so rule 49 governs.
The written ki takes the ASV's When under rule 55; the supplied a and the belong to the nominals they determine under rule 15.
